components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default red action for giving, registration, visit planning, and live actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: #B3282D; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; transition: background-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(179, 40, 45, 0.18); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9F2429; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(179, 40, 45, 0.70); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary action for directions, learn-more links, and lower-priority page actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 2px solid rgba(179, 40, 45, 0.40); border-radius: 1rem; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1F2937; padding: 1rem 2rem; min-width: 260px; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10); transition: background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: rgba(179, 40, 45, 0.60); background: #F9FAFB; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(179, 40, 45, 0.70); outline-offset: 3px; }

Worship that makes room for Jesus' presence.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 1rem; background: #F9FAFB; color: #1F2937; padding: 2rem; min-height: 12rem; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(179, 40, 45, 0.40); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10); } .ds-card-icon { margin: 0 auto 0.75rem; color: #B3282D; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1; text-align: center; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; color: #1F2937; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; text-align: center; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

components.name: Floating Label Input
components.description: The registration and visit form field pattern with red validation and soft focus.
components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; display: block; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; border: 1.5px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 14px 12px; font-size: 15px; color: #1F2937; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.70); outline: none; transition: border-color 250ms ease, background-color 250ms ease, box-shadow 250ms ease; } .ds-field span { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 14px; padding: 0 4px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #9CA3AF; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; pointer-events: none; transform-origin: left top; transition: transform 250ms ease, color 250ms ease, font-size 250ms ease; } .ds-field input:focus { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(229, 231, 235, 0.60); } .ds-field input:focus + span, .ds-field input:not(:placeholder-shown) + span { transform: translateY(-30px) scale(0.85); color: #B3282D; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Desktop Navigation Link
components.description: Large, tight, heavy Montserrat navigation with an animated red underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding: 0.5rem; color: #374151; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav-link span { position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-nav-link span::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -0.125rem; height: 2px; width: 0; background: #B3282D; transition: width 300ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #1F2937; } .ds-nav-link:hover span::after, .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page'] span::after { width: 100%; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page'] { color: #B3282D; }

narrative.overview: The Life Place uses a restrained, welcoming brand system built from white space, soft grays, local photography, and one unmistakable red. The visual language should feel like a clear invitation: warm, direct, practical, and centered on the repeated phrase "Come. See. Jesus."
keyCharacteristics: White and light gray surfaces with brand red used sparingly and deliberately.
Heavy Montserrat type, especially in hero statements and navigation.
Rounded cards, buttons, drawers, and fields that feel approachable rather than formal.
Local imagery, grayscale treatments, and dark overlays when text sits on photography.
Motion that reveals and responds, never distracts from the invitation.

rules.name: The Red Is Reserved Rule
rules.body: Brand red is not decoration. Use it for Jesus emphasis, primary action, active state, validation, live state, or an explicitly important link.

rules.name: The White Canvas Rule
rules.body: Default surfaces stay white or near-white. Gray panels should organize content; they should not make the site feel boxed in.

rules.name: The Heavy Means Important Rule
rules.body: Use 900 weight only for major invitation, navigation, or page structure. Do not make every card title black and enormous.

rules.name: The No Decorative Mono Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce monospace labels for style. This brand is warm and pastoral, not technical.

rules.name: The Flat First Rule
rules.body: A surface starts flat. Add shadow only for hover, open menus, media containers, floating actions, or form blocks.

rules.name: The No Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: If the shadow looks black, sharp, or like a 2014 app, it is too strong.

dos: Do use Church Door Red for primary calls to action, live indicators, active navigation, and the word Jesus when it is intentionally emphasized.
Do keep the default page canvas white with Heading Ink for headings and Body Ink for paragraphs.
Do use Montserrat consistently across display, navigation, labels, forms, and body copy.
Do pair large theological statements with generous vertical spacing and restrained supporting copy.
Do use real local imagery and photo-backed sections when a page needs place, people, worship, ministries, or visit context.
Do use soft rounded forms and cards, especially rounded-xl, rounded-2xl, and rounded-3xl.
Do include hover, focus, active, disabled, valid, and error states for interactive components.
donts: Don't use red as a background wash across ordinary sections. Its rarity is what gives it meaning.
Don't introduce purple gradients, neon accents, glass cards, or generic SaaS landing-page effects.
Don't use gradient text for headings. Existing gradient-text instances should be treated as exceptions to remove during polish.
Don't use side-stripe borders thicker than 1px as decorative accents. Existing left borders should remain functional information markers only.
Don't replace photography with abstract color blocks where visitors need to understand the real place or community.
Don't add a second display font, decorative serif, or monospace styling unless the full brand direction is intentionally changed.
Don't make every surface a card. Use full-width white sections and simple layout first.
